statements.t: (NASDAQ: VTIX) (“Virtuix” or the “Company”), a leading developer of AI-driven, full-body simulation systems, today announced that it expects to report strong revenue growth for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027, ended September 30, 2026, driven in part by increased Omni One sales following the Company’s June launch of Omni One for Quest in collaboration with Meta.

Jan Goetgeluk, Virtuix’s Chief Executive Officer and Chairman, and Thomas McGinnis, Chief Financial Officer, will host the conference call and present a detailed overview of the Company’s fiscal second quarter performance, commercial traction, outlook for fiscal year 2027, and key growth initiatives designed to support long-term shareholder value creation.

“We are excited to share what we anticipate will be a standout quarter for Virtuix, driven by meaningful growth in Omni One revenues following our successful launch of Omni One for Quest in collaboration with Meta,” said Jan Goetgeluk, Chairman and CEO of Virtuix.
The replay can also be viewed through the webcast link above, and the presentation utilized during the call will be available on the Company’s investor relations web site here.
